name: perp_template_single_tile_crossing
notes: G1 (offpath campaign, #675). Originally authored to pin the perpendicular-template rung; solved_by attribution (added for the #687 review) proved that rung UNREACHABLE on this shape. Causal chain: on the only single-tile iteration, the item-conflict gate in junction_solver (two items on one boundary tile) skips EVERY strategy and grows the region; the rung then refuses any region larger than one tile (ghost_router's tile_count guard). Each gate is correct in isolation; together they make the rung's belt×belt arm dead for two-item crossings — the exact shape it was written for. This fixture therefore pins the PINNED-TIER CORE ladder's dispatch on the canonical two-item single-tile crossing (sat-1ug-native solves it on a grown region, bridging the tap under the trunk; auto-tier extras are outside the replay's scope — see README) and stands as the regression record of that reachability finding: if solved_by ever changes, the core ladder's dispatch on this shape changed. max_cost is padded to 17 over the measured 14 for varisat cost wobble across machines (precedent: electronic_circuit_copper_cable_missing_input_chain's notes); the solved_by pin itself is stable — SAT/UNSAT per rung is deterministic for a fixed formula, only the solution's cost wobbles. The rung's internal pipe×belt logic is pinned separately by perp_template_pipe_belt_bridge.json (production dispatch currently filters pipe specs before the rung can see them — see that fixture's notes).
